sentences.en: Jupiter is the most massive planet in the solar system.
sentences.zh: 木星是太阳系中质量最大的行星。

sentences.en: The nearest star to our solar system is Proxima Centauri.
sentences.zh: 比邻星是我们太阳系最近的一颗恒星。

sentences.en: The problem is that solar energy just costs too much.
sentences.zh: 问题是太阳能的成本太高了。

senses.zh: 太阳的，和太阳有关的；（与）太阳能（有关）的
